d:
Official music video for the original single "Butterfly" by Vidya Vox from the Mad Dream EP.
Hey guys! Hope everyone is doing well during these crazy times! Shankar and I wrote "Butterfly" about stepping out of your comfort zone and pushing your boundaries, and how we can grow from that. This song is from the Mad Dreams EP. Huge shoutout to Shankar for directing and shooting this video. Big shoutout to my quarantine buddies/roomies Kavita Rao for letting me borrow her phenomenal skirt, and showing me how to move my two left feet, and Neel, who was the playback man!
